why: The item is a definition. A (universe 0) is the single theorem isGeneralizedIso_iff_isIso: IsGeneralizedIso f ↔ Mathlib's IsIso f in the project's category EPLoc. B (universe 0) checks the project's definitions against the text, in three parts. (1) Every generalized map is a class homMk d = ⟦d⟧. (2) [d] = [d'] iff d and d' have a common refinement. (3) IsGeneralizedIso [d] iff some diagram e has [e] ∘ [d] = [1_X] and [d] ∘ [e] = [1_Y], written with Diagram.comp, Diagram.id and EquivB. B holds outright (B_holds): Quotient.exists_rep, Quotient.eq, and the definitional facts homMk d ≫ homMk e = homMk (d.comp e) and 𝟙 (of X) = homMk (id X). A also holds outright (IsIso is the same existential). So both directions are proved without their hypotheses and are vacuous for the audit. The substantive finding is B_holds: the project's generalized maps and generalized isomorphisms are the text's, with the composition order matching ([e] ∘ [d] = homMk d ≫ homMk e = [d.comp e]).
